name: terraform-aws
description: Create Terraform infrastructure for AWS deployment
request_pattern: Create Terraform configuration for AWS. Deploy: ${resources}. Include: VPC with public/private subnets, security groups, IAM roles with least privilege, S3 backend for state, variables.tf with sensible defaults, outputs.tf, and a README with deployment instructions. Use ${aws_region} region.

variables.resources: ECS Fargate service with ALB, RDS PostgreSQL, and S3 bucket

guidelines: Use variables for all configurable values
